say:2:1131050002:0.text: I was on a good pace when a sandstorm suddenly broke loose. Couldn't see two inches in front of my nose!
say:2:1131050002:0.source_cn: 我本来赶路赶得好好的，结果突然刮起了沙暴！那个风沙吹得...
say:2:1131050002:0.male: I was on a good pace when a sandstorm suddenly broke loose. Couldn't see two inches in front of my nose!
say:2:1131050002:0.female: I was on a good pace when a sandstorm suddenly broke loose. Couldn't see two inches in front of my nose!

say:3:1131050003:0.text: Suddenly felt air beneath my feet and well... now I'm down here.
say:3:1131050003:0.source_cn: 然后……我一个没站稳，就摔到这里来了。
say:3:1131050003:0.male: Suddenly felt air beneath my feet and well... now I'm down here.
say:3:1131050003:0.female: Suddenly felt air beneath my feet and well... now I'm down here.

say:4:1131050004:1.text: My leg is in rough shape. If standing up hurts, I don't even wanna think about climbing out of here.
say:4:1131050004:1.source_cn: 最倒霉的是，我的腿受伤了，连站起来都费劲，更别说爬上去了。
say:4:1131050004:1.male: My leg is in rough shape. If standing up hurts, I don't even wanna think about climbing out of here.
say:4:1131050004:1.female: My leg is in rough shape. If standing up hurts, I don't even wanna think about climbing out of here.

say:5:1131050005:1.text: Hopefully, I heal up soon. Still need to get after the treasure!
say:5:1131050005:1.source_cn: 但愿过一会儿能好点。我还得去找宝藏呢！
say:5:1131050005:1.male: Hopefully, I heal up soon. Still need to get after the treasure!
say:5:1131050005:1.female: Hopefully, I heal up soon. Still need to get after the treasure!
